objective: To let VPLD monitor the Service Acceptance approved in SA Approval (SA Number generated), with deliveries and approved cost.
To monitor the ELIPS -> PAS interface and the PAS feedback: PAS PR Number, PAS PR Date, PAS PO Number, interface status and errors.
To keep ELIPS (SA Approval snapshot) and PAS data clearly separated for 3-way matching and audit.

data_map.note: Search, detail, log and export do not change data. PAS feedback and the interface batch are background processes (Operation 5.9).

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Criteria: SA Date From = 1st day of previous month, To = system date (TBD); Status and Truck Company = All; tab Service Acceptance List.
Access: VPLD / IELP Admin all SA; Supplier own trucking company; Driver no access (message no. 1).
Only SA generated by SA Approval (SA Number present) are shown; this screen never generates an SA Number (SM-01).
Two SA types: Delivery (route-based delivery cost) and Monthly Truck (monthly truck cost of a released Fixed Cost PO, refer UISS SA Approval 5.9).
5.2 Search
SA approval date in range; SA Number / Delivery Number / PAS PR / PAS PO contains; Status = Interface Status; Truck Company = code; Delivery Date equals; PAS PO empty.
Sort SA Approval Date descending, SA Number; server-side paging 10 / 25 / 50. No data: 'No Data Found' (message no. 2).
5.3 ELIPS data vs PAS data
ELIPS (SA Approval snapshot, read only): SA Number, SA Det No, deliveries, trucking, route, Total KM, ELIPS cost reference PO, rate, cost, approval date / by (SM-10).
PAS feedback: PAS PR Number, PAS PR Date, PAS PO Number - empty until received; never generated by ELIPS, PR Date never taken from SA / interface / system date (SM-03).
The ELIPS PO used for cost is never overwritten by the PAS PO Number (SM-04).
5.4 WBS columns
Percentage per WBS (CS, RRE, RRR, SP, CE, CI) from the service type of the cycles; cost = Price x percentage. Source WBS Consumption Master and service type: TBD (OQ-10).
5.5 Interface Status

rows: PAS PO received, PR not yet

operation.text: Status = COMPLETED if PR and PO, PR_RECEIVED if PR only, PO_RECEIVED if PO only, SENT if none; FAILED on send error or PAS error feedback (SM-07). Existing ELIPS-PAS standard replaces this model (OQ-02).
Overdue flag: SENT / PR / PO received without feedback for more than 24 h (TBD). Visual only.
5.6 Detail
Sections A-G with source labels (ELIPS / PAS feedback). Read only.
5.7 Interface Log / Audit

Events SA_APPROVED, SA_SENT_TO_PAS, PAS_REQUEST_SUCCESS, PAS_REQUEST_FAILED, PAS_PR_RECEIVED, PAS_PO_RECEIVED, PAS_FEEDBACK_FAILED, PAS_PROCESS_COMPLETED with time, actor, correlation ID, previous / new status, error.
5.8 Retry Interface
Shown for FAILED SA without PAS values; enabled only with the retry authorization (IELP Admin, proposed, OQ-08); backend checks again (message no. 6).
Status PROCESSING, attempt + 1, same correlation ID; result SENT (message no. 4) or FAILED with error (message no. 5).
PAS-side failure (PR / PO creation failed) is not resent; PAS sends the missing data later (message no. 7).
5.9 Background processes (outside this screen)
Interface batch: sends NOT_SENT SA from the outbox, retries PAS_UNAVAILABLE / TIMEOUT automatically (5, 15, 60 min, 3 attempts - TBD).

PAS feedback API: idempotent by feedback id; matched by SA Number + correlation ID; staged PR then PO update the same SA; conflicts, unknown SA, missing PR No / PR Date / PO No rejected and logged; PO received sets Daily orders 'SA Approved with PO Number'. Refer UISS-Batch PAS Interface (TBD) and docs/sa-monitoring-spec.md §13-§20.
Integration errors never remove an SA from this screen (SM-11).
5.10 Open Questions

items: G-SA-01 SA number length: Existing logic kept: SA number ILS/TR/<LP>/<YYMMDD><NNNN> up to 22 characters (sa-rules.js saNumber). DCR-29: ALTER ielp.SA_DETAIL.SA_CODE and ielp.ORDER_CYCLE.SA_CODE varchar(16) -> varchar(25).
G-SA-02 Amounts as text: Existing logic kept: numeric KM / price / cost; stored as plain numbers in the existing varchar columns. No DB change: mapping as stated.

G-SA-03 Total KM / rate per KM: Existing logic kept: Total KM, rate per KM and currency kept on the SA (sa-rules.js calculate). DCR-30: ADD ielp.SA_DETAIL.TOTAL_KM decimal(9,2), RATE_PER_KM decimal(15,2), CURRENCY varchar(3).

G-SA-04 Status codes: Existing logic kept: SA statuses and types of sa-rules.js / sa-pas-rules.js. DCR-31: Register code values (SA_HEADER.STATUS_CODE, SA_TYPE, SA_DETAIL.STATUS_CODE) - data, no column change.

G-SAM-01 Interface tracking: Existing logic kept: interface tracking with correlation id, attempts, error code / message (sa-pas-rules.js). DCR-33: ADD ielp.SA_DETAIL.CORRELATION_ID varchar(60), INTERFACE_ATTEMPT int, ERROR_CD varchar(30), ERROR_MSG varchar(500).
G-SAM-02 VISION columns: Existing logic kept: VISION columns are not used by the TC-PBR logic. No DB change: mapping as stated.
